comparison_set: Research OS Cycle Exploration Safety Protocol

adoption_manifest.exact_reusable_contract: Given a finite nonzero factor set with all squareclass-relevant pair products and shared-prime channels known exactly, construct an edge-labelled graph in K*/K*^2 and solve the vertex squareclasses in terms of independent live reservoirs, without requiring those reservoirs to have fixed finite prime support.
adoption_manifest.APPLICABILITY: multi-factor square receivers where prime sharing is controlled but remains parameter-dependent
DO_NOT_USE_FOR: S34-W01 exhaustiveness without a separate finite-support theorem
adoption_manifest.exact_distinction_rationale: S34-W01 requires a finite exhaustive squareclass branch family before downstream closure. This contract stops earlier and has a different output: a complete parametric compatibility graph whose reservoirs may remain live and unbounded.

adoption_manifest.exact_reusable_contract: For a source receiver carrying an exact order-two involution, transport the involution on the full receiver data, pass to invariant coordinates/fixed field, classify fixed and boundary loci, and prove an exact converse reconstruction so that the descended equations are an iff quotient receiver rather than a j-invariant or model-level analogy.
HYPOTHESES: receiver equations and auxiliary square roots equivariant
adoption_manifest.APPLICABILITY: Diophantine receivers with a genuine algebraic involution that preserves the full source condition
DO_NOT_USE_FOR: quotient point implies rational source point without lift proof
adoption_manifest.exact_distinction_rationale: S30-W02 is semilinear finite-action Galois descent; this is a rational algebraic involution on the full receiver with exact quotient and converse. S34-W03 acts only after such a dictionary exists.

adoption_manifest.exact_reusable_contract: Starting from an exact quotient receiver, identify the additional rational-source lift condition as an iff discriminant/square condition, then change coordinates so that the receiver and that lift condition become an explicit Kummer-style square system with forward and converse rational reconstruction.
HYPOTHESES: nonzero denominators on the retained open
adoption_manifest.APPLICABILITY: quotient receivers where rational points of the quotient over-cover the rational source and the missing lift can be expressed by exact square data
adoption_manifest.exact_distinction_rationale: S33-PW09 binds a named Brauer class to a genuine cohomological Kummer lift in a locked marking; S31-W01 certifies quartic-to-elliptic rational maps. Neither supplies an algebraic rational-source lift condition for a quotient receiver.

adoption_manifest.exact_reusable_contract: For a completed square receiver whose equations acquire a common reciprocal factor after exact elimination, factor out the shared term, give explicit forward/inverse square-root scalings, and replace the original system by a strictly smaller iff receiver while recording whether the reciprocal symmetry preserves the physical chamber.
HYPOTHESES: forward/inverse square-root scales rational and nonzero
adoption_manifest.APPLICABILITY: coupled Kummer/norm/square systems with reciprocal paired factors
DO_NOT_USE_FOR: physical descent when chamber is not preserved
new character/isogeny credit already present upstream
adoption_manifest.exact_distinction_rationale: S34-W03 excludes an exact receiver intersection and S31-W01 transports genus-one models; neither performs an exact common-factor compression of a completed simultaneous square receiver.

adoption_manifest.exact_reusable_contract: Classify primes for a finite-field degeneration property by exhaustively checking all primes below an explicit threshold, then construct a smooth auxiliary curve/family for the complement and use a proved Weil lower bound minus an explicit bad-point bound to guarantee a nondegenerate witness for every prime above the threshold.
HYPOTHESES: projective/canonical normalization for exhaustive small-prime census
explicit auxiliary curve or family for large primes
Weil lower bound stronger than bad-point count beyond a proved threshold
adoption_manifest.APPLICABILITY: all-prime local-support or degeneration classifications where small primes are exceptional and a bounded-genus auxiliary family supplies large-prime witnesses
adoption_manifest.exact_distinction_rationale: S34-W03 proves emptiness/degeneracy of a specified receiver intersection, potentially with one local witness. This contract classifies the complete exceptional-prime set for a local property and proves witnesses for every remaining prime by finite census plus a uniform Weil completion.

adoption_manifest.exact_reusable_contract: Extend S34-W01's pre-enumeration stage to record an exact bounded incidence table of pairwise gcd reservoirs and separate odd-prime from sign/2-adic support even when the reservoirs remain parameter-dependent; fail closed before finite squareclass enumeration unless a fixed finite support theorem is supplied.
adoption_manifest.APPLICABILITY: S34-W01 candidates whose gcd support is explicit but dynamically parameter-dependent
adoption_manifest.exact_distinction_rationale: Same main interface as S34-W01 factor/gcd/valuation descent, but Stage35 supplies a useful explicit failure contract: complete dynamic support data can still be insufficient for the finite exhaustive branch output required by S34-W01.

adoption_manifest.exact_reusable_contract: Extend the existing Gaussian divisor/orientation machinery by requiring an exact independence test for a second source orientation: quotient exact relabelings/mirrors, fix unit/conjugation ambiguity, and only then extract the joint quadratic-field squareclass or equivalent rational-coordinate square condition from two genuinely distinct oriented square factorizations.
HYPOTHESES: exact test that the second orientation is not a source relabeling
adoption_manifest.APPLICABILITY: Gaussian/norm receivers with more than one natural orientation
DO_NOT_USE_FOR: generic Gaussian factorization as new content
necessary square condition as global obstruction
adoption_manifest.nearest_existing_card: Stage14 AR-017/AR-018 historical Gaussian orientation machinery
adoption_manifest.exact_distinction_rationale: The Gaussian factorization and orientation vocabulary already exist in the Arsenal lineage. Stage35 adds a sharper verification/failure contract for two orientations, so extending that interface is preferable to a new ID.

adoption_manifest.exact_reusable_contract: Extend S34-W01 applicability with a primitive three-object pair-gcd normalization: from gcd(A,B,C)=1, extract pairwise-coprime shared gcds x,y,z and private cofactors A=xy*a, B=xz*b, C=yz*c, then derive only those cofactor coprimality/parity relations justified by the source equations before squareclass descent.
HYPOTHESES: three positive integers with total gcd one
source equations make each pairwise reduced pair primitive
parity conclusions derived from those source equations
adoption_manifest.APPLICABILITY: three-variable Diophantine systems whose equations are naturally reduced face/pair equations before factor-square descent
DO_NOT_USE_FOR: fourth/global equation restriction not separately proved
adoption_manifest.exact_distinction_rationale: This is an upstream normalization that feeds the same factor/gcd/valuation interface already owned by S34-W01. It expands applicability and guards unsupported coprimality, but it does not create a different terminal output.

adoption_manifest.exact_reusable_contract: When a long quotient/descent/compression chain returns to variables satisfying an endpoint-like model, freeze the original endpoint contract and classify every returned predicate as inherited, newly derived, or forbidden-to-reuse; require an explicit reverse/source adapter before re-importing primitive, orientation, or source-only hypotheses.
adoption_manifest.APPLICABILITY: long algebraic proof chains that return to an earlier geometric or endpoint model and risk circular reuse of assumptions
DO_NOT_USE_FOR: reverse population equivalence without an adapter
reusing source-specific hypotheses merely because equations look identical
adoption_manifest.exact_distinction_rationale: S30-WF03 controls upward semantic credit across typed layers. It does not explicitly police circular re-import of source predicates after a transformed route algebraically returns to an earlier endpoint model; this workflow adds that distinct loop-return check.

rejection_rationales.DISC-S35-A01: REJECT_DUPLICATE: the coprime product rectangle is elementary exact gcd/factor bookkeeping inside S34-W01's factor/gcd descent interface; the upstream double-Pythagorean extraction remains source-specific.
rejection_rationales.DISC-S35-B01: REJECT_DUPLICATE: a four-factor product-square receiver is exactly an S34-W01 input shape; S34-W01 already states factorization != complete squareclass list and product-square does not imply factorwise squares.
rejection_rationales.DISC-S35-B03: REJECT_DUPLICATE: exact marked Picard/Galois transport is S33-PW04's interface.
rejection_rationales.DISC-S35-B04: REJECT_DUPLICATE: proper Picard G-module to algebraic-Brauer semantics is already covered by the Stage33 marked/Brauer stack; the Stage35 numerical proper-surface result is retained separately as Stage35-specific D02.
rejection_rationales.DISC-S35-B05: REJECT_DUPLICATE: finite support assignments followed by symmetry/Burnside orbit quotient are ordinary finite equivariant classification already represented by S30-W01/W03 and add no new arithmetic interface.
rejection_rationales.DISC-S35-B06: REJECT_DUPLICATE: forward/inverse population marking with gauge/orientation controls is an instance of S33-PW04.
rejection_rationales.DISC-S35-C01: REJECT_DUPLICATE: materially new receiver -> fresh exhaustive-view/blind breadth audit is already required by the Research OS Cycle Exploration Safety Protocol.
rejection_rationales.DISC-S35-C02: REJECT_DUPLICATE: BLOCK ledger, anti-loop preservation, non-impossibility wording, and reopen/parking discipline are already in the Cycle Exploration Safety Protocol.
rejection_rationales.DISC-S35-C03: REJECT_DUPLICATE: exact locator -> adapter -> verifier -> immutable provenance is covered by S30-WF02/S30-WF03 together with S33-PW04/S33-WF01.
rejection_rationales.DISC-S35-C04: REJECT_DUPLICATE: receiver-matched theorem replacement is exactly S34-WF01.
rejection_rationales.DISC-S35-C06: REJECT_DUPLICATE: exact-head immutable replay/provenance discipline is already S30-WF02 plus repository audit policy.

implementation_rules: Harvest 4 may assign formal stable IDs only to the five NEW_WEAPON roles and one NEW_WORKFLOW role after exact ID-space check
EXTEND_EXISTING candidates modify existing authoritative source/registry contracts rather than create new IDs
do not promote historical/negative, Stage35-specific, or rejected duplicate candidates
preserve all frozen hypotheses, failure contracts, source heads, blobs, and PROVISIONAL maturity
run Arsenal catalog/card sync only in Harvest 4 after explicit implementation begins
